n: Techquity Aotearoa Godot video game unit
t: A 12 week unit where students make their own games in Godot 4.
steps: Find the Techquity Aotearoa unit page and read its overview.
Ask IT to install Godot 4 on student computers.
Try the Basic Video Game Skills tutorials.
Try the Piskel pixel art editor.
Adapt the standards to your own course and set the sprint dates.
Decide whether students will share games on itch.io. Accounts are optional.
